title: Contraction of two trace maps through tensor actions
statement:
Let $\mathcal C_X,\mathcal C_Y,\mathcal C_Z$ be monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category]. Let $F_f:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal C_Y$, $F_g:\mathcal C_Y\to\mathcal C_Z$ be functors and $P_f:\mathcal C_Y\to\mathcal C_X$, $P_g:\mathcal C_Z\to\mathcal C_Y$ strong monoidal functors [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor]. Write $\delta_{f;N,N'}:P_f(N\otimes N')\xrightarrow{\sim}P_fN\otimes P_fN'$ for the inverse tensor comparison, $\alpha$ for tensor associators, and $\lambda:\mathbf1\otimes B\xrightarrow{\sim}B$ for left unitors. For $u=f,g$ suppose given natural isomorphisms
$$\operatorname{PF}_{u;M,N}:F_uM\otimes N\xrightarrow{\sim}F_u(M\otimes P_uN),\qquad q_{u;M,N}=\operatorname{PF}_{u;M,N}^{-1}.$$
The maps need only be given on full domains closed under every object, arrow and structural comparison displayed here; each equality below is restricted to those domains. Assume the tensor-action equation for $f$:
$$\operatorname{PF}_{f;M,N\otimes N'}=
F_f\bigl((1_M\otimes\delta_{f;N,N'}^{-1})\alpha_{M,P_fN,P_fN'}\bigr)
\operatorname{PF}_{f;M\otimes P_fN,N'}(\operatorname{PF}_{f;M,N}\otimes1_{N'})
\alpha_{F_fM,N,N'}^{-1}.$$
Composition is written right to left.

Choose objects $L_f\in\mathcal C_X$, $L_g\in\mathcal C_Y$ and arbitrary morphisms $t_f:F_fL_f\to\mathbf1_Y$, $t_g:F_gL_g\to\mathbf1_Z$. Define, for every permitted $B$,
$$d_{u,B}=\lambda_B(t_u\otimes1_B)q_{u;L_u,B}:F_u(L_u\otimes P_uB)\to B.$$
Put $L=L_f\otimes P_fL_g$, $a=d_{f,L_g}:F_fL\to L_g$ and $b=t_gF_g(a):F_gF_fL\to\mathbf1_Z$. For $K\in\mathcal C_Z$ set
$$\sigma_K=\alpha_{L_f,P_fL_g,P_fP_gK}^{-1}(1_{L_f}\otimes\delta_{f;L_g,P_gK}):
L_f\otimes P_f(L_g\otimes P_gK)\xrightarrow{\sim}L\otimes P_fP_gK.$$
Then the following equality holds as morphisms from $F_gF_f(L_f\otimes P_f(L_g\otimes P_gK))$ to $K$:
$$d_{g,K}F_g(d_{f,L_g\otimes P_gK})=
\lambda_K(b\otimes1_K)q_{g;F_fL,K}F_g(q_{f;L,P_gK})F_gF_f(\sigma_K).$$
No adjunction or comparison between $F_gF_f$ and a third functor is assumed.
